item.title: More key US allies block military flights as Iran war rift widens with Trump
item.summary: President Donald Trump blasted France, Spain, Italy and the U.K. on Truth Social, criticizing their refusal to support U.S. military operations tied to the war with Iran.

item.title: American journalist kidnapped in Iraq, employer says
item.summary: Award-winning American journalist Shelly Kittleson has been kidnapped in Iraq according to Al-Monitor, a publication that provides coverage of the Middle East.

item.title: Trump says Tiger Woods 'lives a life of pain' after DUI arrest as affidavit reveals pills found
item.summary: President Donald Trump says Tiger Woods "lives a life of pain" after the golfer's DUI arrest in Jupiter Island, adding that the golfer "doesn’t have an alcohol problem."

item.title: Heart attack damage reversed with injectable RNA therapy, study finds
item.summary: Columbia University scientists developed a two-step RNA therapy that may repair cardiovascular tissue after a heart attack by turning muscles into a "healing protein factory."

item.title: Trump admin to hold global summit on countering Antifa, sources confirm
item.summary: The Trump administration is considering a global summit to counter Antifa and left-wing extremist networks, saying they pose a transnational terror threat.

item.title: Missing paddleboarder found dead in Old Tampa Bay after a weekend disappearance near the causeway
item.summary: A man who went missing while paddleboarding near the Courtney Campbell Causeway was found dead in Old Tampa Bay on Monday, police said. Foul play is not suspected.

item.title: Pelosi reveals she's finally spoken to Joe Biden amid sour relationship over his 2024 campaign exit
item.summary: Nancy Pelosi confirmed she and former President Joe Biden have spoken after their lengthy feud, saying she gets far more credit and blame than she deserves for pushing him out in 2024.

item.title: Foreign grads sideline US-trained doctors in coveted programs, bombshell complaint alleges
item.summary: Do No Harm filed a civil rights complaint accusing Corewell Health, Texas Tech, and HCA Healthcare of favoring foreign-trained doctors in residencies.

item.title: Gunmen on bikes storm Nigeria village on Palm Sunday, killing at least 20
item.summary: Gunmen on motorcycles shot sporadically into a Nigerian community on Palm Sunday, killing at least 20, residents say, prompting a 48-hour curfew in Plateau state.

item.title: Illegal alien alleged groping of minor girls at high school being investigated by Education Department
item.summary: The Education Department has launched “yet another investigation" into Fairfax County, Virginia, after reports of an adult illegal alien student allegedly groping a dozen minor girls.
